title: Fula Music - Melodigging
text: Fula music (also called Fulani, Fulɓe or Pulaar/Fulfulde music) encompasses the vocal and instrumental traditions of one of the largest Sahelian peoples, spread from Senegal and Mauritania across Guinea, Mali and Niger to Cameroon and beyond. It is deeply tied to pastoral lifeways, Islamic scholarship, and praise‑song traditions.
